Thomas Eriksen  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 0000 | thomas.eriksen@email.com | linkedin.com/in/thomas-eriksen  
  

Professional Experience  
At NexCart Solutions, I’ve focused on building robust data infrastructure to support e-commerce analytics. My work includes designing scalable data pipelines that process over 10 million daily transactions, ensuring real-time insights for inventory and pricing strategies. I’ve also led the migration of historical data to Snowflake, optimizing query performance by 35% through schema refinement and partitioning. This project involved collaboration with cross-functional teams to align data models with business KPIs.  

In my role as a Data Engineering Intern at Ecometrics Group, I contributed to the development of ETL pipelines using Apache Spark, reducing data processing latency by 20%. I also supported the implementation of data modeling best practices, which improved data consistency across 12+ datasets. At VividTech, my internship involved cleaning and visualizing sales data, which helped identify underperforming product categories, leading to a 15% increase in targeted marketing ROI.  

Technical Skills  
Snowflake serves as the backbone of our data architecture, where I’ve made strategic decisions on schema design, security configurations, and role-based access. I’ve mentored two junior engineers on query optimization techniques and helped establish governance policies for data lineage. For data warehousing, I’ve designed dimensional models that integrate transactional data with customer behavior metrics, enabling more accurate forecasting.  

Apache Airflow is integral to our workflow, where I’ve configured DAGs to automate data pipeline orchestration. This includes monitoring dependencies between ETL jobs and implementing retries for failed tasks. Docker has been used to containerize data processing microservices, ensuring consistent environments across development and production. PostgreSQL remains a critical component for transactional data, where I’ve optimized indexing and query performance for high-traffic use cases.  

Terraform automates infrastructure provisioning for cloud resources, streamlining deployments for our data lakes. My work with Apache Spark has involved processing large-scale datasets, often in collaboration with data scientists to refine feature engineering pipelines. These efforts have directly impacted business outcomes, such as improving campaign targeting accuracy by 25% through enhanced data segmentation.  

Projects  
Developed a real-time analytics dashboard for NexCart’s e-commerce platform, integrating data from Snowflake and PostgreSQL. The solution reduced report generation time by 40% and provided actionable insights for seasonal promotions.  

Designed a data warehouse for customer behavior analytics, incorporating dimension tables for user segments and fact tables for purchase history. This structure enabled complex aggregations and supported a 30% improvement in query efficiency.  

Built an ETL pipeline to consolidate sales data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality through automated validation checks. The pipeline processes 50GB of data daily and feeds into our analytics suite.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Oslo, 2022. Focused on distributed systems and database management, with coursework in data modeling and cloud computing.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Norwegian (native)  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2023)  
Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2023)
